title: Eleven Employers
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：range　|　正文 388 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 range 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The agency my mother worked for occupied one room above a bakery and dealt with a ① range of people most offices never meet: night-shift nurses, a man who would only work outdoors, two brothers who would not work on the same site. The ② range of jobs on our board was narrower — eleven employers, all within six miles — and the range, she said, is the whole difficulty of the job: too few places, too many people, and no honest way of choosing between them.

Her own ③ range of skills was mostly administrative and mostly invisible: she could tell in four minutes whether somebody would last a month. Wages ④ ranged from the legal minimum to about twice it, and the difference was usually a shift nobody wanted. Within ⑤ range of the bus route employers paid a little more; beyond it they paid nothing, because nobody could get there at five in the morning.

In my last summer there I was given the board. Every Monday I ⑥ ranged the cards in order of date and rewrote the ones nobody had read in a fortnight. A ⑦ range of reasons was offered for not taking a job — the hours, the bus, the smell of one particular factory — and my mother listened to all of them as if they were arguments in a debate she was enjoying. Beyond the ⑧ range of hills to the north the buses did not go and the wages were worse.

The bakery below was the reason the room was warm and the reason it smelled. Its ⑨ range had been there since 1954, and the baker, a man of few opinions, held that bread is the only product a customer judges twice a day. He sold the usual ⑩ range of loaves and one thing nobody bought, which he made anyway, for eleven years, on a Thursday.

My mother retired in 2019 and the agency closed six months later, which surprised nobody and upset everybody. What she had, I now understand, was not a method but a tolerance: for the same story told badly, for the bus that never came, for the fact that the range of what she could offer was always smaller than the range of what was needed. I have worked in three offices since, and not one of them has ever admitted that.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 一系列；各种各样（a range of）
C. n. 山脉；山峦（a range of hills）
D. n. 炉灶；烤炉（厨房设备）
E. v. （在一定幅度内）变化；变动（range from ... to）
F. 固定搭配：within range of 在……可及的范围内
H. v. 排列；整理（range sth in order）

items.q: a range of people most offices never meet
The range of jobs on our board
Wages ranged from the legal minimum
Within range of the bus route
I ranged the cards in order of date
A range of reasons was offered
Beyond the range of hills to the north
Its range had been there since 1954
He sold the usual range of loaves

answers.why: a range of people 意为“各种各样的人”，指形形色色的求职者。
指岗位数量的“范围、幅度”，说这块公告板上的工作范围很窄。
指技能所覆盖的“范围”，说她的本领多半是行政类的、看不见的。
range from ... to 是动词用法，意为“在……之间变动”，指工资从法定最低到约两倍。
within range of 意为“在……可及的范围内”，此处指公交线路能到的地方。
range 作动词意为“排列、整理”，指每周一把卡片按日期排好。
a range of reasons 意为“各种各样的理由”，与首段 a range of 同义。
a range of hills 意为“一条山脉”，指北面那道山岭。
range 指厨房的“炉灶、烤炉”，故说它从 1954 年就在那儿了。
指面包店供应的“品种、系列”，说他还做一样没人买的东西。
